issues.summary: converter_utils.py is a god module with 87 importers, creating a large blast radius
evidence: 87 model files import from converter_utils.py — any change to a converter helper (e.g. from_str, from_int) forces re-evaluation across the entire model layer
The module mixes date/time converters, string converters, list converters, enum converters, and UUID converters with no internal grouping
issues.suggestion: Split converter_utils.py into focused sub-modules: primitive_converters.py (str/int/float/bool), date_converters.py (datetime/timedelta), collection_converters.py (list/dict), enum_converters.py. Re-export all from converter_utils for backward compat. This bounds blast radius per type of change.

issues.summary: rankings_models.py shim in directus_ffbb blurs the boundary with the shared models/ package
evidence: directus_ffbb/models/rankings_models.py re-exports RankingEngagement and TeamRanking from models/ — these are shared models not specific to Directus
Consumers importing from directus_ffbb.models.rankings_models get the same object as models.ranking_engagement, making the boundary ambiguous
issues.suggestion: Remove the shim if no external consumers depend on it, or document explicitly that it is a transitional shim with a deprecation notice. Consumers should import shared models directly from ffbb_api_client_v2.models.

root_causes: backward-compat shims persisting without active need
